name: LIFTLINE

steps.title: Lay the desktop face down
steps.detail: On a rug or the box lid, so the top doesn't scratch.

steps.title: Screw on the top brackets
steps.detail: One near each end, lined up with the pre-drilled holes.

steps.title: Bolt the crossbar between the brackets
steps.detail: Leave the bolts a turn loose for now.

steps.title: Fit the motor legs
steps.detail: Motor cables point to the middle. Now tighten the crossbar bolts too.

steps.title: Bolt on the feet
steps.detail: The long ends of the feet face the front edge of the desktop.

steps.title: Screw the control box under the top
steps.detail: Plug both leg cables into it, M1 left and M2 right.

steps.title: Screw on the handset
steps.detail: Under the front edge on the right, buttons facing you, then plug it into the control box.

steps.title: Turn the desk upright
steps.detail: Lift it together from the long sides, never by the legs alone.

steps.title: Reset the height
steps.detail: Plug in, then hold the down button until the desk stops and beeps. It now knows its lowest point.

tips.legs: Keep the leg cables free of the crossbar so they don't get pinched when the desk moves.

watchOut: Check nothing is under or above the desk before you press up or down.
